Package frc.spectrumLib.gamepads

Class Gamepad

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.gamepads.Gamepad
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subsystem
Direct Known Subclasses:
Operator, Pilot
public abstract class Gamepad extends Object implements Subsystem
Base class for the robot's Xbox-compatible gamepads. Wraps a WPILib CommandXboxController and exposes the buttons, bumper and trigger combinations, stick axis helpers, and rumble commands that bindings need.

Subclass once per operator role (pilot, copilot) and bind subsystem commands to the triggers that are set up here.

When Gamepad.Config.isAttached() returns false, every trigger stays false for the life of the object and axis reads return 0.0, because no controller is constructed.
